history.summary: A very large 2,174 sqft 99-yr leasehold 3BR in Bishan-fringe D20 at $3.18M — the $1,463 PSF looks cheap only because the unit is oversized, and the $3.18M quantum sits well above the liquid band. Strong data (82 txns, 5.11%/yr) and the future Cross Island Line (Teck Ghee) are real positives offset by the punishing quantum.
history.rating_rationale: 82 txns and 5.11%/yr URA appreciation are solid, and a future CRL station (Teck Ghee, ~2030) is a catalyst. But at $3.18M the quantum is far above the $1.8-2.5M deep-liquidity band — buyer pool thins sharply, and the low $1,463 PSF is an oversized-unit artefact (2,174 sqft), not value. Score_1000 of 508 reflects the quantum/liquidity drag. The big unit suits own-stay more than a 5-7yr investment flip.
red_flags: $3.18M quantum well above the liquid band — slow, shallow exit
Low PSF is a function of a 2,174 sqft oversized unit, not value
catalysts: Future Cross Island Line at Teck Ghee (~2030) — connectivity uplift
Bishan-fringe/Ang Mo Kio with strong schools and amenities
